title: ExposureFindings
description: Schema for reporting validated attack surface security exposures

type.description: Type of asset, e.g. web_server, domain, ip, api_endpoint

value.description: Primary value or URL of the asset

exposure_tag.description: Deterministic canonical tag for ingestion deduplication: <issue_slug>:<normalized_target> (e.g. exposed-git-repository:api.example.com)

title.description: 10-15 word concise title describing confirmed security issue

description.description: Concise technical description of what was observed and validated (max 50 words)

impact.description: Explain concrete security consequence an attacker can achieve (max 50 words)

remediation.description: Practical remediation required to eliminate demonstrated exposure (max 50 words)

steps_to_reproduce.description: Clear step-by-step instructions to reproduce exact same result (max 70 words)
